researchNotes: Official Byredo US/EU product pages opened (listing pages 1-6 of 98 products, then each product page). Pages give notes, concentration and a "good to know" descriptor but no perfumer or year, so those are null. Family taken from the first fragrance-type descriptor in "good to know" where present. Absolu de Parfum and Night Veils extracts listed as separate entries. Body mists, hair perfumes, roll-ons, sets, discovery kits and holiday items skipped. Super Cedar lists no notes. Mojave Ghost EDP page was read on the eu_en site, the rest on us_en. Not covered (not on the listing pages seen): older/discontinued names.

fragrances.name: Future Memories
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: one review 6-9 h, a Scento user about 7 h, Parfumo users rate longevity 8-9/10; projection disputed (Vivir 3.0/5, another Vivir page says soft by hour four). Scento suggests fall/winter evenings.

fragrances.name: Bal d'Afrique

sources.name: Parfumo — Bal d'Afrique EDP user review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries of reviews: most cite 6-8 h on skin (Parfumo reviewer ~7 h); sillage described as moderate. One outlier source says 4-6 h.

fragrances.name: Mojave Ghost
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summary of a Scento review: a retailer puts it at about 5-7 h, another review 4-7 h; EDP described as soft, intimate and close to skin, not a projector.

fragrances.name: Gypsy Water

sources.name: Vivir — Byredo Gypsy Water EDP review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review (opened): 3-5 h on skin, softly projecting, subtle trail, rated 2.5/5 longevity; Spring rated best, fall to avoid. Retailer FAQ 4-6 h and Parfumo reviewers 6-8 h; most reviewers call sillage weak.

fragrances.name: Blanche
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most sources give 4-8 h on skin (retailer 6-8 h, a lower estimate 4-6 h); sillage described as moderate.

fragrances.name: Rose of No Man's Land

sources.name: Byredo — Rose of No Man's Land
Vivir — Byredo Rose of No Man's Land review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: retailer and review pages mostly 6-8 h, Vivir review 8-10 h; sillage moderate (Vivir 3.0/5, projects at arm's length for a few hours).

fragrances.name: Alto Astral
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento: long-lasting with moderate projection, suited to summer and daytime; Maxaroma estimates 6-8 h with an intimate-to-moderate aura.

fragrances.name: Black Saffron
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: most estimates 4-6 h on skin (up to 8 h on clothing); a retailer lists 6-8 h. Sillage moderate per retailer, tight in an older blog review.

fragrances.name: Desert Dawn

sources.name: Scent Verdict — Byredo Desert Dawn EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries disagree: a retailer 7-9 h, another listing 5-7 h, one reviewer 30-60 min, another 4 h. Sillage described as soft and close to the skin, subtle for office wear. Most common view used.

fragrances.name: Bibliothèque
fragrances.performanceEvidence: A review database gives 6-10 h and retailers 7-9 h; Scento describes moderate projection; reviewers point to autumn and winter as its best seasons.

fragrances.name: Super Cedar
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: listings say 6-8 h and moderate sillage; individual reviews are mixed (some say it fades within hours, one says long-lasting with great sillage). Most common view used.

fragrances.name: Young Rose
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume.com and Scents Angel give 6-8 h with moderate sillage; some users report it fading within an hour.

fragrances.name: Inflorescence
fragrances.performanceEvidence: WhatScent community ratings: longevity 3/5, projection 2/5, sillage 2/5; Fragrance Review calls longevity moderate and sillage mild.

fragrances.name: Flowerhead
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel 6-8 h and Maxaroma about 7 h; Scentverdict rates it moderate (4-6 h) with strong projection; most sources call sillage moderate.

fragrances.name: La Tulipe

sources.name: Beauty The Shop — Byredo La Tulipe EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: A retailer lists about 6-8 h and a moderate scent trail; Scento: moderate longevity and projection, suited to spring and summer daytime.

fragrances.name: Eleventh Hour
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: retailers give 4-6 h on skin, one info page 6-8 h, a Parfumo reviewer 8-9 h; sillage moderate, close to skin.

fragrances.name: Mixed Emotions

sources.name: Vivien's Smells — Byredo Gypsy Water & Mixed Emotions

fragrances.performanceEvidence: A blogger reports 5-6 h with light to medium sillage; another retailer cites about 7 h; many reviewers say it wears close to the skin.

fragrances.name: Oud Immortel
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries: Perfume.com 6-8 h, Scents Angel 8-10 h, Parfumo average 7.7/10 with one user at about 4 h; sillage generally moderate. Most common view used.

fragrances.name: Eyes Closed

sources.name: Venba Fragrance — Byredo Eyes Closed EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba lists about 7-9 h with moderate-to-strong sillage; Scents Angel 6-8 h; The Sniff Test moderate longevity and sillage; a Parfumo reviewer finds it best in autumn and winter.

fragrances.name: M/Mink
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo community ratings: longevity about 8.1/10, sillage about 7.1/10; a WhatScent user gave longevity 4/5.

fragrances.name: De Los Santos
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento aggregated reviews: longevity 4.3/5 with moderate projection; typical 6-8 h; WhatScent users give sillage 3-4/5.

fragrances.name: Mumbai Noise
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 8+ h and strong but refined sillage; Scento: long-lasting with strong projection; The Sniff Test calls sillage moderate.

fragrances.name: Pulp
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Search summaries of Parfumo and Hwahae reviews: roughly 8+ h on skin, strong projection and very strong sillage at the start; Scentverdict calls it potent. Competitor claim of 6-8 h not used.

fragrances.name: Slow Dance
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailers list about 6-8 h and 7-9 h, Perfume.com says six hours or more; sillage is usually described as moderate; a few guides put it nearer 4 h.
